title: Multistate income-tax apportionment
prompt:
Prepare the FY26 multistate income-tax apportionment for the controller's close review.

Start with the tax-provision and EBITDA-definition correspondence in `Requests/`, including the close-review follow-up. Use the v4 controller-review workpapers, jurisdiction detail, tax provision review notes, and signed reporting policy as the current support. Keep the v2 pre-close workbook as change history only, and resolve differences using the approval status, dates, document status, and management correspondence. Keep this analysis tied to the controlling tax sources rather than the posted accounting ledger.

Use the approved apportionable income and calculate each jurisdiction's sales, property, and payroll factors under the 50% sales, 25% property, and 25% payroll weighting. Apply each statutory rate and available state NOL subject to the documented 80% utilization limit. Reconcile apportioned taxable income before NOL to the company total, then show net state tax after NOL for Oregon, Washington, California, and Idaho. Report the blended rate, gross liability before NOL, NOL benefit, net state tax, and the jurisdiction with the highest net state tax.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `oregon_state_taxable_income`, `washington_state_taxable_income`, `california_state_taxable_income`, `idaho_state_taxable_income`, `oregon_net_state_tax`, `washington_net_state_tax`, `california_net_state_tax`, `idaho_net_state_tax`, `blended_state_tax_rate`, `gross_state_tax`, `state_nol_benefit`, `net_state_tax`, `highest_tax_jurisdiction`. Use dollars to two decimals and ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals.
